category: hosted AI agent runtime on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tier: Free plan; paid Basic, Pro and Enterprise plans

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 500 credits a month, 1 auto-provisioned agent, starter tools, short-term memory, limited model choice, a shared workspace and console-only access; upgraded plans are Basic 5,000, Pro 50,000 and Enterprise custom credits a month

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an agent invocation, not a stored object; the request body and file caps are not published on the pricing page

retention.stated: short-term memory within a session on Free and Basic; short plus long-term memory on Pro and Enterprise; conversations expire on their own with TTL-based cleanup and no published TTL value

egress.terms: the invoke response is the payload; a code example calls https://api.jalebi.chat/agents/agt_xyz/invoke with an X-API-Key header; no separate egress allowance, price or outbound-host policy is published on the pricing page

interface_detail: POST /agents/{id}/invoke over REST, AG-UI over WebSocket for conversations, and generated MCP or A2A servers; API keys are listed from the Basic plan upward and the Free plan is console only
tooling: an HTTP client with an X-API-Key header, or a generated MCP server for Claude Desktop and Cursor, or an A2A peer
chaining: agents run on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with registered tools, connections and knowledge sources; a deployed agent can also be reached as an MCP server or an A2A peer

limits.value: 500 credits a month on Free, 5,000 on Basic, 50,000 on Pro, custom on Enterprise; premium models consume more credits per call
1 agent on Free, 10 on Basic, 25 on Pro; one shared workspace on Free versus 3 dedicated on Basic and 10 on Pro
the developer API advertises rate limiting, but no numeric rate is published on the pricing or features pages

limits_note: the Free plan has console-only app integration; API keys start at Basic; the numeric cost of one credit and the monetary price of the paid plans are not published on the page read
binding_note: the monthly credit allowance is published as a number while the rate-limit and credit-to-call conversion are not, so 500 credits on one agent binds first

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the Free plan says 'Get started instantly' and plans list a 'Talk to Us' contact, but no sign-up page was reachable and no registration fields are published; email is the assumed kind because an agent console with workspaces needs an account, and a card is not stated for the Free plan

reliability_note: the jilebi.chat host has no DNS A or AAAA answer and the pricing page was reached only through a provider rewrite of jalebi.chat; the numeric rate limit and credit conversion are not published
confidence_note: the plan table was read from the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-24 through a pinned provider; the interface example and feature statements come from the vendor's own pages the same day

notes: The seeded host jilebi.chat has no DNS answer; the vendor's own site is jalebi.chat, whose pricing page was read. The Free plan publishes a monthly credit figure, one agent and a shared workspace, but no monetary price, credit conversion, numeric rate limit or sign-up fields. This is a hosted agent platform; the BYOC option runs the same platform in the reader's own cloud account and is a later option than the hosted plans.
